title: Content Handoff
description: Structured handoff from Content Writer to editor, SEO Analyst, or publisher upon completing an article, post, or content piece. Consumed by SEO Analyst (for post-draft audit), Reviewer (for editorial check), and the publishing workflow. Pairs with seo-metadata.json for final publication metadata. Includes GEO/AEO execution evidence, typed non-commodity value (unique POV / first-hand evidence; schema field names keep the information_gain prefix for compatibility), E-E-A-T signals, and aligned source credibility per the research-report.json source hierarchy.

site.description: Target site slug (e.g. leaseinvietnam, maylanhtreotuong, vesviet, learn).

content_path.description: Repo-relative path(s) to the content file(s) created or updated.

status.description: Content status at time of handoff.

primary_keyword.description: Primary SEO keyword targeted by this content.

word_count.description: Approximate word count of the content body (excluding frontmatter).

editorial_passes.description: Number of editorial passes completed before this handoff. Minimum 3 when editorial research was performed without Researcher delegation.

research_sources.description: Sources used in the content. Credibility aligned with research-report.json source hierarchy.

credibility.description: Source tier: Primary (gov/official/peer-reviewed), Secondary (reputable news/expert/industry), Tertiary (Wikipedia/reference), AI-generated (query-use only — never cite).

unverified_claims.description: Claims that could not be fully verified and may need fact-checking before publication.

information_gain.description: Typed non-commodity value (unique POV/first-hand evidence) gate — documents what unique value this article adds beyond existing top SERP results. Mandatory quality gate; not optional.

type.description: Primary type of non-commodity value (unique POV / first-hand evidence) this article delivers.

description.description: Specific explanation of what this content adds that is not present in top-3 SERP results for the primary keyword.

gate_passed.description: True when non-commodity value (unique POV / first-hand evidence) is documented and the draft is not merely a rewrite of existing SERP content.

geo_aeo_fields_applied.description: Machine-readable GEO/AEO execution evidence. Consumed by SEO Analyst for post-draft audit and A2A pipeline validation.

answer_first_implemented.description: Direct answer block (≤60 words) placed after each H2 heading for informational/commercial queries.

query_fanout_covered.description: PAA-sourced and LLM-suggested sub-questions addressed in the article body.

query_fanout_missed.description: Sub-questions from brief that were not covered — flagged for SEO Analyst review.

answer_formats_used.description: Answer formats applied per section, matching the seo-content-brief.json specification.

fact_density_met.description: True when ≥3 verifiable data points (statistics, specific numbers, sourced expert quotes) per 500 words.

fact_density_notes.description: Optional: note any sections where fact density fell short and why.

faq_implemented.description: True when FAQ block is present (brief or SERP competitors required it).

heading_hierarchy_clean.description: True when H1 → H2 (query intent) → H3 (sub-questions) hierarchy is consistent.

eeat_signals.description: E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) signal audit. Consumed by SEO Analyst and Reviewer.

experience_proof_type.description: Type of experience proof signal specified by the SEO brief or required by the domain.

experience_proof_implemented.description: True when the required experience proof type is present in the draft.

experience_proof_notes.description: If not implemented, explain gap and escalation path. Never fabricate experience signals.

author_entity_referenced.description: True when author name and profile reference are included (required when brief specifies it).

trust_signals_present.description: True when source citations with links, verifiable claims, and contact/policy references are in place.

ymyl_domain.description: True when content touches health, legal, financial, or safety domains. Elevated E-E-A-T and Researcher delegation required.

internal_links_added.description: Internal page paths linked from this content (minimum 3 when seo-content-brief.json specifies).

open_questions.description: Open editorial or fact-checking questions for the next reviewer.

recommended_next_roles.description: Roles that should act on this content next. technical-writer when content must align with technical source-of-truth docs.

source_data.description: Reference to the primary structured input: research-report.json, seo-content-brief.json, or feature-ticket.json path/ID.

publish_log_updated.description: True when publish-log.md has been updated after confirmed publish (required when overlays/seo-publishing is active).

ai_semantic_flaw_score.description: Anti-AI semantic flaw evaluation. Measures robotic patterns, blacklisted cliches, burstiness, and ungrounded claims.

flaw_score.description: Composite penalty score from 0 (flawless) to 100 (heavily flawed). Max 15 allowed to pass.

gate_passed.description: True when flaw_score <= 15, zero blacklisted cliches detected, and active voice >= 85%.

cliche_count.description: Count of blacklisted AI clichés found ('delve', 'tapestry', 'testament', 'unlock', etc.). Must be 0.

cliches_detected.description: List of specific AI clichés detected in the text.

burstiness_std_dev.description: Standard deviation of sentence lengths in words. Natural human cadence requires >= 6.0.

active_voice_percentage.description: Percentage of sentences constructed in active voice. Target >= 85%.

ungrounded_claims_count.description: Number of factual claims lacking empirical sources or firsthand evidence. Must be 0.

information_gain_rating.description: Information gain rating evaluated against Top 10 SERP competitors. 'exceptional' or 'strong' required for publish.

geo_readiness_checklist.description: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) readiness checklist for AI Search visibility (Google AI Overviews, SearchGPT, Perplexity).

answer_first_bluf_verified.description: All H2 sections begin with concise Bottom-Line-Up-Front answer <= 60 words.

entity_salience_optimized.description: Target entities and disambiguation attributes are placed in lead positions.

structured_comparison_tables.description: Quantitative data and trade-offs presented in markdown tables or structured lists.

quotable_fact_density_met.description: >= 3 verifiable data points per 500 words formatted for standalone quote extraction.

schema_jsonld_prepared.description: Structured data specifications (TechArticle, Person E-E-A-T, FAQPage) prepared.

llms_txt_compatible.description: Key takeaways formatted for ingestion into site llms.txt index.

all_gates_cleared.description: True when all required GEO readiness criteria are satisfied.

gen_ai_visibility.description: AI-surface visibility fields captured at/after publish (2027 reframe).

non_commodity_element.description: The unique POV / first-hand evidence element that makes this piece non-commodity (replaces raw information-gain phrasing).

gen_ai_impressions_first_week.description: Search Console Gen AI report impressions for this URL in its first week post-publish (0 if not yet available).

citation_samples.description: Number of repeated citation sampling runs logged before any cited/not-cited conclusion (single-run conclusions are invalid).

ai_assistance_disclosed.description: Whether AI assistance is disclosed when reasonably expected.

included_in_gen_ai_features.description: Site confirmed included in 'Search generative AI features' eligibility in Search Console.
